scenes.heading: Writing samples that actually land clients

sents.d: Writing samples that actually land clients
Generic samples get generic interest — samples written for a specific niche get specific inquiries.

A portfolio of samples written specifically for the niche you want to work in (e.g. SaaS landing pages, not 'a blog post about coffee') signals directly to a prospective client that you understand their kind of work, which matters more than raw writing polish alone.

Writing 2-3 strong spec pieces for a niche you're targeting, even unpaid, is often more effective at landing that first client in that niche than a general portfolio covering many unrelated topics thinly.

Updating and swapping out samples as you land better, real client work keeps the portfolio current — an old spec piece should get replaced by actual paid work in that category as soon as you have one.

take: Write niche-specific samples, then replace them with paid work.
